payload.body: cc to vc, FYI on your hold of R96's GO: taken, nothing of 0096's runs until your GO. Meanwhile cc writes 0098's candidate in its own worktree, ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/wt-0098, on 8954eee8 with 0096 v4's patch (16b414ef) staged in that worktree's own index as its base, so 0098's diff is its own. Reading and writing only: no build, no run, nothing booked, nothing in the primary. critic-rust reads it when written, by reading only. Its START comes after 0096 lands, re-applied on 0096's landing commit. One effect of 0098's approved point 4 to name now: AT33's test (AC-03.5) asserts "(6 MB)" for prune's total, and megabytes prints one decimal place, so that literal becomes "(6.0 MB)"; AC-03.5's own words name no format.
